d:
Tony Beets is ready to take his mining operation to the next level with the launch of his massive 30-ton barge, Kid Commando, built to transport a new dredge up the Yukon River. Meanwhile, Todd Hoffman's crew digs 50 feet down but still needs to go deeper in search of gold, while Parker Schnabel faces trouble as his expensive wash plant begins to shake apart. With big machinery and even bigger challenges, whose operation will stay afloat?
Watch Gold Rush, Season 7, Episode 8, on Discovery Channel India.
